annotations.title: Convert old address to new (2025 reform)

description: Convert a Vietnamese administrative address from BEFORE 1 July 2025 (old province, district, commune) to the unit(s) valid AFTER the 2025 reform. Use when the user has an old address, an old ID card or registration address, or asks "what is my ward called now". Pass the parts you have; names may be written with or without diacritics, with prefixes or abbreviations, or as official codes. Returns the old unit, the new commune and province, the new address line, transition type (merge, unchanged, rename, retype, special_zone), partial=true when only part of the old commune went there, and resolution numbers. If the old commune was split between several new communes, ALL of them are returned and ambiguous=true: do not pick one, ask for the street or hamlet. Examples: {"province":"TP.HCM","district":"Quận 8","ward":"Phường 16"}; {"province":"Bình Dương","district":"Thủ Dầu Một","ward":"Phú Cường"}; {"ward":"27430"}.

district.description: Old district (quận / huyện / thị xã / thành phố): name, abbreviation (Q.1, H. Củ Chi) or 3-digit code.

province.description: Old (pre-1 July 2025) province or city: name with or without diacritics, abbreviation (TP.HCM, HN) or 2-digit code. A post-reform province name is also accepted.

ward.description: Old commune-level unit (phường / xã / thị trấn): name, abbreviation (P.16) or 5-digit code.

name: convert_old_to_new
